sources.title: Developments in electron beam and friction technologies
sources.titleEn: Developments in electron beam and friction technologies
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 電子束材料接合概念
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付扭矩－轉角功圖與能量／品質差異說明。；教學結構扭矩限值 2.5 N·m，2 N·m 案通過、3 N·m 案失敗，接合品質仍未證明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a torque-angle work plot and energy-versus-quality explanation.; A teaching structural limit of 2.5 N·m accepts 2 and rejects 3 N·m; weld quality remains unproven.
related.difference: 以理想抽氣模型研究腔體時間成本與漏氣底限，全程離線。
related.differenceEn: Study chamber cycle time and leak floor with an ideal offline pumpdown model.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 恆扭矩旋轉功 W=τθ=τ2πN，轉數 N 無量綱。；抽象教學模型 τ=2 N·m、N=5 轉，無實際接合或旋轉設備操作。；W=2×2π×5=62.8319 J。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At constant torque, W=τθ=τ2πN, where turn count N is dimensionless.; Abstract teaching model: τ=2 N·m for five turns, with no joining or powered rotation.; W=2×2π×5=62.8319 J.
Ideal leak-free p=p0 exp(−St/V), so t=(V/S)ln(p0/pf).; Teaching V=0.10 m³, S=0.010 m³/s and p0/pf=1000, using only a pressure ratio.; t=(0.10/0.010)ln1000=69.0776 s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 大型砂模鑄造
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付扭矩－轉角功圖與能量／品質差異說明。；教學結構扭矩限值 2.5 N·m，2 N·m 案通過、3 N·m 案失敗，接合品質仍未證明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a torque-angle work plot and energy-versus-quality explanation.; A teaching structural limit of 2.5 N·m accepts 2 and rejects 3 N·m; weld quality remains unproven.
related.difference: 從外模、砂心與基準偏移推算最薄壁，建立可辨認偏心與整體縮放的量測計畫。
related.differenceEn: Infer minimum wall from mold, core and datum offset, distinguishing eccentricity from global scale error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 恆扭矩旋轉功 W=τθ=τ2πN，轉數 N 無量綱。；抽象教學模型 τ=2 N·m、N=5 轉，無實際接合或旋轉設備操作。；W=2×2π×5=62.8319 J。
圓形同心殼的名義壁厚=(外徑−內徑)/2；砂心橫移 e 使一側減 e、對側增 e。 合成外徑 500 mm、砂心直徑 460 mm、偏心 3 mm；教學最低壁厚要求 18 mm。 名義厚度 20 mm，最薄 20−3=17 mm，最厚 23 mm；最薄比教學下限少 1 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At constant torque, W=τθ=τ2πN, where turn count N is dimensionless.; Abstract teaching model: τ=2 N·m for five turns, with no joining or powered rotation.; W=2×2π×5=62.8319 J.

For a concentric circular shell nominal wall=(OD−ID)/2; core shift e removes e on one side and adds e opposite. Synthetic OD 500 mm, core diameter 460 mm and eccentricity 3 mm; teaching minimum wall 18 mm. Nominal wall is 20 mm; minimum 17 mm and maximum 23 mm, leaving the minimum 1 mm below the teaching gate.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
